reviews.text: Expensive but always open...and that's important
Thank you, Ennio Sorrento. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.

Although the staff was friendly, I must point out that the hair dryer, which is cold and turns on simultaneously with the extractor fan, making a deafening noise, isn't ideal for a dog who already dreads baths. I also had to rush the process because the shop only has one stall, as the second one would be broken.
In fact, to speed things up, I left the shop with the dog still wet.
